subject: general
question: P sold an article to Q at 11% profit and Q sold it to R at 11% loss. If R paid ₹19,758 for it, then at what price (in ₹) was the article purchased by P?
solution:
**Given:**

P sold an article to Q at 11% profit.

Q sold it to R at 11% loss.

R paid ₹19,758 for the article.

**Formula Used:**

Let the cost price of the article for P be x .

Selling Price (SP) from P to Q = Cost P
